help.title: Help & contact
help.subtitle: We're here to help. Contact us or check the most frequent questions.

faq.q: How do I track my order?
faq.a: Go to Account → My orders and open the order. You'll see its status (paid, preparing, shipped, delivered) and the tracking number once it has shipped.

faq.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: We accept major credit and debit cards through Stripe, a secure payment provider. We never see or store your card details.

faq.q: Why am I charged in US dollars?
faq.a: Prices can be shown in your local currency for information, but payments are processed in USD. Your bank converts the amount at its own rate.
Yes. Contact us within 14 days of delivery with your order number and we'll guide you through the return.

faq.q: How do I change my delivery address?
faq.a: Go to Account → Addresses to add or edit an address. If your order has already shipped, contact us as soon as possible.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: Go to Account → Delete account. Your personal data is removed permanently.

terms.p: TechZhop is an online store selling electronics and accessories. By using our website or app, you agree to these terms.
You are responsible for keeping your password secret and for all activity on your account. You must provide accurate information.
Prices are shown in US dollars; other currencies are estimates. An order is confirmed once payment is accepted. We may cancel an order in case of a pricing error or lack of stock, with a full refund.
Payments are processed securely by Stripe. We do not store your card details.
Delivery times are estimates. You will be notified of the status of your order in your account.
You may return an unused product within 14 days of delivery. Refunds are made to the original payment method once the product is received.
Products are covered by the manufacturer's warranty. TechZhop is not liable for indirect damages resulting from the use of the products.
For any question about these terms, contact us from the Help & contact page.

privacy.p: Your name, email, phone number, delivery addresses, orders and, if you choose, a profile photo.
To create your account, process and deliver your orders, provide customer support and, only if you agree, send you offers.
Card payments are handled by Stripe. We never receive or store your full card number.
We share data only with the providers needed to run the service (hosting, payment, delivery). We never sell your data.
Your data is stored securely by our hosting provider (Supabase) and protected by access controls.
You can view and edit your information at any time in your account, and delete your account permanently from Account → Delete account.
You can turn order and promotional notifications on or off at any time in Settings.
For any privacy question, contact us from the Help & contact page.
